function.name: list_files
function.description: Lists the files in a directory.

path.description: The path to the directory to list.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Reads the content of a file given its path.

path.description: The path to the file to be read.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Runs a shell command on the local system. The user approves it first.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Creates or overwrites content to a file at the given path.

path.description: The path to the file to be written.

content.description: The content to write to the file.
